Class JsonArray

java.lang.Object
gate.lang.json.JsonArray
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonCollection, JsonElement, Serializable, Iterable<JsonElement>, Collection<JsonElement>, List<JsonElement>, SequencedCollection<JsonElement>
public class JsonArray extends Object implements List<JsonElement>, JsonCollection
Represents a JSON array as a List of JsonElement.

This class provides a comprehensive API for creating, manipulating, and converting JSON arrays in Java. It implements the List interface with JsonElement elements, allowing standard Java collection operations.

The class supports:

  • Type-safe adders for primitive types
  • Conversion to and from Java collections
  • JSON parsing and formatting
  • Optional-based value retrieval to handle missing indices safely
  • Stream-based factory methods for functional programming
Author:
Davi Nunes da Silva
